caveats: overlapping structural motifs, not a chemist's unique classification
kekule-invariant by the delocalised-bond rule, NOT tautomer-invariant (2-pyridone and 2-hydroxypyridine differ)
instance precision checks type presence in the parent, not location or multiplicity
replay failures occupy top-k slots as empty predictions
recall mixes model coverage with the conservative determined rule
the reference rows that use the parent structure (label_ceiling, recipe_fragments) are not baselines
evaluation: functional groups determined inside each predicted graph (ms2-fg-v3), compared as type sets with the true parent's groups; parent structure used only as the label

candidate_formula_prior.description: plain prior set minus types whose needed elements are absent from the spectrum's best-formula_log_prob eligible record (top-ranked formula hypothesis among allocated trajectories; unallocated hypotheses are not exposed)

recipe_fragments.description: union over the label recipe's candidate fragments (at most two bond cuts, 3 to 16 atoms): coverage of the recipe, not a ceiling for the model

vocabulary.heteroatom: every type except carbonyl, alkene, alkyne, arene_ring (ids 1, 14, 15, 24)
